correctness.rationale: For any embedding, the lower-level sets form an antichain on their union U, so Sperner gives |U|>=mu(a). At least two pairwise incomparable upper-level sets must each properly contain U, giving h*>=mu(a)+1. Minimality of mu(a) ensures a chosen middle-layer antichain of size a covers all mu(a) coordinates; adjoining b distinct new coordinates constructs an induced copy at rank mu(a)+1. At that rank, any embedding forces exactly b distinct coordinates outside the union, so w*=mu(a)+b. The central-binomial inequality gives equality with a+b exactly for a=2,3,4.
